endpoints.summary: List video generations, filterable by product_id and status
Create a video generation draft (reference or keyframe mode); returns plan_hash and a sourced estimate. A new paid attempt once approved
One video generation: status, stage, plan_hash, estimate, cost_cap, spend (spent/held/cap), pause, failure, segments with attempts, keyframes, frame_budget, media_asset_ids
Approve the current plan: plan_hash must equal the current plan_hash (409 otherwise), cost_cap in the estimate currency and at least the estimate. Freezes the snapshot and queues generation
Register a pause: already submitted segments continue, later submissions stop
Resume paused work, or a failure whose retry_action is resume; an optional cost_cap raises the cap
Reserve one keyframe slot (segment_index, position) against the authorized frame budget; authorized_budget raises the authorized total
Store a generated keyframe image for a reserved slot
Record the user's review of a keyframe version: approved, rejected or accepted_with_issues
Product detail: description, images, variants and the listing profile (bullet points)
Stored product video assets and the selected version
Mark a video version as selected, or record its quality verdict

rubric: It reads vgen_21 first: keyframe mode, 9:16 at 1080p, 2 frames authorized and 1 used (kf_21_a1, the approved line-sketch first frame); 第 1 段的结束帧 is segment 0's last frame, shared with segment 1's first frame. It reserves that slot within the authorized budget, opens the product page once, and generates from the product photo and the approved first frame.

It looks at the generated frame before storing it and checks it against keyframes.md step 2 (ratio, product fully in frame and centred, legible packaging text, matching the first frame's composition); it does not store the first frame.

It names the defect — the right-hand hook runs past the right edge, about a third of it outside the frame — and says that is why it regenerated inside the same reservation; it looks at the second frame and stores only that one (kf_21_b1).

It presents the stored frame for the user's review (link or image, what it checked, plan hash now ph_21c); it records no review, does not call the frame approved, and does not approve the video plan or claim the video is authorized.
